messages:
rachel: Quick sync: finalizing rollout plan for 'dynamic-model-routing' feature. main question: shadow-first vs direct micro-canary for tenant opt-ins. thoughts? :thinking_face:
lia: I'd prefer shadow-first for 24-48h in a single region (us-east-1). lets us validate correctness and cache behavior without impacting latency/SLOs.
tom: Shadow is great for safety, but remember it won't surface tail latency or queueing effects. we should follow shadow + tiny timed canary (0.25%) for 6 hours to validate latency.
rachel: ok so flow = shadow 24h -> 0.25% canary -> 2% -> 10% -> 50% -> full. we'll gate each step by telemetry.
charlie: flag plan: global gate + region gates + tenant opt-in override. naming proposal:
```yaml
- dynamic.routing.v2: global boolean (default: false)
- dynamic.routing.v2.region: map of region->pct
- dynamic.routing.v2.tenant: map of tenant_id->enabled
```
all flags immutable for 5m after change to avoid flip flapping.
lia: ops thresholds we want wired into the rollout automation:
- P95 latency increase > 7% for 10m -> pause and alert
- 5xx rate delta > 0.4% absolute for 5m -> instant fallback to baseline variant
- token queue depth > 200 in any AZ for 3m -> route to fallback
add an embedding-sim drift monitor: if embedding sim drops > 0.04 over sample window, flag for QA.
tom: For A/B we will run parallel cohorts for quality: control(baseline), expA(routing-compress), expB(kv-proxy). sampling rate: 1 in 200 requests instrumented for human review. downstream metric: NPS for the feature, and CTR on suggestion endpoints.
charlie: customer-driven tenant opt-in process:
1) SE files ticket with tenant id + justification
2) PM approves and notes expected window
3) Ops toggles tenant flag scoped to canary region only
4) Monitor for 48h; if stable, allow cross-region opt-in
make sure RBAC + audit logs are mandatory.
pm-bot: NOTE: billing impact: routed requests may change GPU usage; finance wants an estimate for any customer pilot exceeding 100k tokens/day.
rachel: thanks. we'll require finance sign-off for pilots >100k tokens/day.
lia: Automation: add a timed rollback job so if a gate fires we automatically revert region flags and notify pager with runbook link. also create a 'safety-window' lock that prevents scaling changes during canary.
tom: Runbook snippets to include in the page:
- how to manually flip `dynamic.routing.v2.tenant[<id>]`
- how to force fallback variant via header `X-Model-Variant: baseline-v2`
- steps to re-run offline evals if embedding drift alarm fires
charlie: QA checklist before canary: offline eval no regression, smoke tests in staging, end-to-end sampling hooked to human label queue, alerting targets in place.
rachel: tentative schedule: shadow starts next Tue 08:00 PT, canary Wed 10:00 PT. rollout meeting Friday 09:30 PT to sign off. invite sent to SRE, ML, Support, and Sales ENG.
devops-bot: Deployment job scheduled: `ci/shadow/dynamic-routing/v2` started 1788001120. logs: https://ci.internal/jobs/1234 :white_check_mark:
rachel: perfect. please add one more thing: explicit kill-switch that can be flipped globally without chasing region flags. make it very visible in Console.
lia: will do. i'll add console UI + API endpoint: `/api/v1/flags/dynamic.routing.v2/kill` and docs.
tom: final call: shadow 24h -> 0.25% canary (6h) -> 2% (12h) -> 10% (24h) -> 50% (48h) -> full. all gates must be green for moving forward. thanks everyone.
